children: Aethlon Medical announced a definitive agreement to merge with North Immunology in a tax-free, two-step reorganization, supported by an approximately $180 million PIPE expected to fund immediately prior to closing. Based on the exchange ratio framework, pre-merger North Immunology holders (including PIPE investors) would own about 95.25% of the combined company, with Aethlon holders owning about 4.75%. The deal targets a Nasdaq listing and transfers leadership to North Immunology, while Aethlon plans CVRs to return any net proceeds from monetizing legacy Hemopurifier assets. Support and lock-up agreements have been executed to secure approvals and promote post-close trading stability; the merger carries an outside date of June 17, 2027.
